scores.rationale: Irreversible decisions are listed up front with defaults, reversibility ratings and concrete flip conditions.

scores.evidence: "Agree a label taxonomy contract per repo with maintainers. This is the widest rework if wrong, so it goes first."
scores.rationale: Phase ordering puts widest-impact items first (permissions and rulesets, then proxy, before leaf items), with explicit blast-radius reasoning in Phase 2.

scores.evidence: Cross-cutting table Phase 0: "Least-privilege App; key in a secrets manager; sender allow-list; issue text treated as data; sandbox has no credentials"
scores.rationale: Concrete security measures appear in every phase from 0 through 5.

scores.evidence: "One OpenTelemetry trace per issue across every tier. Token and cost metrics. Alerts on worker errors, queue age and spend rate."
scores.rationale: Observability is in Phase 0 with concrete content and extended specifically in each subsequent phase.

scores.evidence: "Replay set pinned to issue IDs and the commit before each fix; harness version and model settings recorded"
scores.rationale: Reproducibility is addressed concretely per phase, from Terraform and digest pinning through pinned embeddings, replay sets and eval regression in CI.

scores.evidence: "Webhook redelivery plus reconcile sweep; idempotency keys; kill switch; rollback by digest"
scores.rationale: Resilience measures appear concretely in every phase, from Phase 0 through per-repo rollback in Phase 5.

scores.evidence: AI layer table: injection defense, cost budget, human approval (Phases 0–1), then retrieval (2), model access, memory (3), orchestration (3), routing (5), feedback (5)
scores.rationale: Defenses, budgets and human approval precede retrieval, then model access, memory, orchestration, routing and feedback in correct order, with minor overlap of basic model call in Phase 0.

scores.evidence: "Closing duplicates or stale issues without approval: when duplicate precision stays ≥ 98% over 3 months of approval-queue decisions."
scores.rationale: Deferred items are listed explicitly, each with a concrete pull-forward condition.

note: Exceptionally thorough plan meeting every dimension with concrete content; only minor quibble is Phase 0 model access ahead of the defense phase, mitigated by sandbox-only exposure.
